name: DPN Automation Scheduler v7
description: Plan, gate, execute, recover, and verify bounded one-time, recurring, and condition-driven automations with persistent evidence.
instructions: Use plan_automation_v7 before creating or changing an automation. Require a valid schedule for one-time/recurring work or a condition for condition-driven work. Preserve approval gates for side effects, checkpoint before risky execution, keep runs idempotent where possible, enforce bounded retries/backoff/runtime, prevent uncontrolled overlap, retain cancellation, and persist failures instead of claiming success. Use evaluate_automation_run_v7 before reporting an automation run complete.
